title: Digestion, Absorption and Dietary Fibre
shortDescription: Where each nutrient is digested and absorbed, and why fibre matters.
genZNote: Digestion is a relay race: mouth → stomach → small intestine → colon. Know who passes the baton to whom and where it all gets absorbed.

table.caption: Sites and enzymes
rows: Bile (emulsifies fat), pancreatic amylase, lipase, trypsin, chymotrypsin
Fermentation of fibre → SCFA; water/electrolyte absorption

sections.heading: Absorption
bullets: Glucose and galactose: SGLT1 sodium-dependent active transport; fructose: GLUT5 facilitated.
Amino acids and di/tripeptides: active transport into portal blood.
Fats: bile micelles → enterocytes → chylomicrons → lymph (lacteals); short-chain fatty acids go directly to portal blood.
Water-soluble vitamins and minerals absorbed in small intestine; B12 in terminal ileum; iron in duodenum.
Villi and microvilli provide ~200 m² surface.

sections.heading: Dietary Fibre
bullets: Non-digestible plant carbohydrates and lignin. Soluble (pectin, β-glucan, gums, inulin): slows glucose absorption, lowers LDL; insoluble (cellulose, lignin): bulks stool and speeds transit.
Fermentation by colonic bacteria yields short-chain fatty acids (butyrate) that nourish colonocytes.
Sources: whole grains, millets, pulses, fruits, vegetables.
Recommended: about 25–40 g/day (ICMR 2020: ~40 g per 2000 kcal); increase gradually with water.
Excess fibre/phytates can reduce mineral absorption.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Digestion hydrolyses macronutrients into absorbable units mainly in the small intestine, while dietary fibre resists digestion and is fermented in the colon with metabolic benefits.
keyFacts: Bile emulsifies fat; lipase digests it.
Fats absorbed as chylomicrons via lymph.

highYieldFacts: Pepsin is secreted as pepsinogen, activated by HCl.
commonTraps: Do not say bile contains digestive enzymes — it emulsifies.
mustRemember: Starch digestion starts in mouth; protein in stomach; fat mostly in duodenum.
